> Descriptions for commands that are modifiable through the **OPTIONS** -> **CLASSICS PATCH** -> **Other settings** menu.

# Menu options

### Game menu
- `sam_bBackgroundGameRender` - Keep rendering the current game in the background of an in-game pause/Escape menu (ON by default).
- `sam_bExtrasMenu` - Replace **MODS** button in the main menu with **EXTRAS** that contains extra functionality (ON by default).
- `sam_bAdjustForAspectRatio` - Set screen's wide adjustment according to the aspect ratio of the game window; fixes HUD display on wide resolutions (ON by default).
  - Replaces functionality of the vanilla `sam_bWideScreen` command, which now acts as an alias for this command.
- `sam_bDecoratedServerNames` - Toggle text decorations in the names of servers in the list, such as color tags and flashing (ON by default).
- `sam_bPatchVersionLabel` - Toggle patch version label in the bottom right corner of the main menu (ON by default).

### Option configs
- `sam_bOptionTabs` - Toggle separation of options by tabs on the left side of the screen (ON by default).
- `sam_bConfigValueLists` - Toggle easy-to-use drop-down lists for config options that have more than 2 values (ON by default).
- `sam_bModernScrollbars` - Toggle usage of proper scrollbars for scrolling the menus instead of old **Page Up** and **Page Down** buttons (ON by default).

### Level filtering
- `sam_bLevelCategories` - Toggle selection of a level category before selecting a level to play (ON by default).
- `sam_bLevelFiltering` - Toggle level filtering options in the level selection menu for easier navigation (ON by default).
